title: Design System: For You Shoe Operations

label.purpose: Forms, statuses, metadata, and table headings.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:42px; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--primary); border-radius:6px; background:var(--primary); color:var(--surface); font:700 15px/1.4 system-ui; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 38%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:42px; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:700 15px/1.4 system-ui; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 38%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for operational settings and phone numbers.
components.css: .ds-input { width:260px; min-height:42px; padding:8px 11px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:400 15px/1.4 system-ui; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--primary); outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 38%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: View Navigation
components.description: Familiar top tabs divide routine work from settings.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); direction:rtl; } .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:8px 2px 12px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:var(--text-muted); font:400 15px/1.4 system-ui; } .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-tab.ds-active { border-bottom-color:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-hover); font-weight:700; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 38%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Pending Status
components.description: Text and color communicate an order awaiting customer confirmation.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 9px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--warning) 28%,var(--border)); border-radius:999px; background:var(--warning-soft); color:var(--warning); font:700 12px/1.4 system-ui; }

components.name: Working Panel
components.description: A single primary work surface, never nested inside another panel.
components.css: .ds-panel { width:320px; padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); box-shadow:0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--text) 8%,transparent); font:400 15px/1.6 system-ui; direction:rtl; } .ds-panel strong { display:block; font-size:20px; } .ds-panel p { margin:6px 0 0; color:var(--text-muted); }

narrative.overview: This interface feels like a well-organized work surface at the center of a busy store: bright enough for daytime use, quiet enough for concentration, and structured around the next operational decision. Familiar product patterns make the system disappear into the order-confirmation task. The system is calm, trustworthy, and efficient.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic-first hierarchy with correct LTR treatment for identifiers.
Operational views for overview, orders, activity, and settings.
Restrained green accent reserved for actions and healthy status.
Progressive disclosure for configuration and response detail.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Ledger Green occupies no more than ten percent of a routine screen and appears only for action, selection, or state.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Success, pending, and failure always include a readable label or symbol; color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: UI labels, buttons, data, and headings use one sans-serif family; display type is prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at the same hierarchy never cast shadows on each other.

dos: Do lead every view with its operational purpose and one primary action.
Do keep routine order work separate from infrequent integration settings.
Do use progressive disclosure for mappings, tokens, and raw provider responses.
Do preserve RTL reading while rendering phone numbers, IDs, and API data LTR.
Do maintain 42px controls, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't use a card-heavy setup wizard.
Don't use arbitrary numbering or decorative dashboard clutter.
Don't expose excessive technical copy before an operator asks for detail.
Don't return to dark styling that makes routine daytime work feel like an incident console.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism, or nested cards.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate status.
